annotations.text:
Gestures (one vocabulary, sides named)
swipe: move highlight / scroll
right-temple tap or R1 ring: select / confirm / open
double-tap (either temple or ring): back, dismiss
long-press: repeat last reply
app exit: Mac shutdown only (no glasses gesture)

This IS the real display: 576x288, 16 green levels on transparent glass, worn while walking.
Brightness tiers here mirror firmware textColor 4/3/2/1 (bright = content, dim = chrome).
Text only in v1 - the selection border on lists is drawn by firmware.
Each frame = one state of the same 5-container page; Menu and Messages are the list layout.

Navigation model: Home is the assistant at rest. Left double-tap opens Menu - the capability nav (Messages, Notifications, Calendar, Debate, Settings; Mail follows the same list pattern later). Each entry opens its data view. Voice cuts across everything: say JOAT + ask from any screen. Long-press anywhere: repeat last reply.
